g.text: “Neither the matrix nor the codebook is updated during self-supervised learning.” — Chiu et al. 2022
normalising the input first is what keeps the projection from collapsing onto a few codes (the paper says so)
the quantiser is decoupled from the model: any encoder, streaming or not (the paper evaluates both)
“consistency over correctness”, taken to the limit: the teacher knows nothing about phones; it only answers the same way twice
